intel_external.title: External intelligence
intel_external.subtitle: Events outside the company, how sure we are of each, and which of our factories, suppliers, materials, orders and customers they may touch.
intel_external.blind_spots: {n} source(s) are failing or stale. What they cover is not being seen; that is not the same as no risk.
intel_external.pending_review: {n} event(s) wait for a person's review (screening alerts or opportunities).
intel_external.new_event_hint: Record a notice from a source that has no feed. Say who published it and how reliable they are: a typed event is no more believable than its source.
intel_external.severity_hint: Leave empty to read it from the text.
intel_external.regions_hint: Countries (ZA, MZ...), provinces, cities. Places named in the text are found as well.
intel_external.conflict_title: Sources disagree. Both are shown; neither is chosen for you.
intel_external.screening_hint: Screening alert: a possible match with a sanctions or restricted-party notice. It is not a legal determination and nothing is done to the supplier on it. Compliance reviews it.
intel_external.regulatory_hint: Regulatory development, stage: {stage}. It may change obligations; it does not mean the company is non-compliant.
intel_external.eligibility_unverified: This appears relevant. Eligibility has not been verified.
intel_external.no_impacts: None of the registered dependencies matched. Check the exposure graph has places and names for your sites, suppliers and materials.
intel_external.reports_hint: Every source that confirms, contradicts or updates the event, with when it published and when we retrieved it.
intel_external.originals_hint: Kept exactly as the source returned them, for review. Treated as data, never as instructions.
intel_external.review_hint: The decision is recorded with your name. Decisions about the business relationship stay with the people responsible.
intel_external.add_report_hint: Another source confirming or contradicting this event.
intel_external.exposures_subtitle: Our factories, suppliers, materials, products, customers, routes, utilities and technology, with where they are and what they are known by. Built from existing records; nothing is created in other modules.
intel_external.unplaced: {n} dependencies have no city or region. Weather and water alerts cannot reach them until a place is set.
intel_external.no_nodes: No dependencies yet. Use “Find from our records”.
intel_external.links_hint: What no record holds: a route that serves a supplier, a utility that feeds a factory.
intel_external.indicators_hint: Prices and rates, indicative, not executable supplier prices. Link a material to one with its indicator code.
intel_external.defaults_hint: Empty means the defaults for this type: {list}.
intel_external.keywords_hint: Names this is known by outside: legal and trading names, product or vendor names. A name match is labelled unverified.
intel_external.sources_subtitle: Where external intelligence comes from, how reliable each source is, its terms, and whether it is working.
intel_external.no_sources: No sources registered. Add a preset below or register your own.
intel_external.presets_hint: Added switched off. Check the terms and jurisdiction before switching one on.
intel_external.url_hint: Public http or https only. Redirects are not followed.
intel_external.credentials_hint: Stored encrypted. Leave blank to keep the current one.
intel_external.terms: Terms of use and access restrictions
intel_external.mapping_hint: How the response becomes items: the path to the list (items) and to each field (title, summary, url, id, published). See the presets for examples.
intel_external.mapping_invalid: The mapping is not valid JSON.

sanctions.CLEARED: Not a match: clear the alert
sanctions.CONFIRMED: Confirmed match: refer to the responsible people

q.customers: Customer commitments that could be delayed
q.shipments: Shipments due in the window or overdue

intel_external.asset_hint: Pin this machine or system to one asset: the impact then follows the work on that asset's work centres.
intel_external.energy_line: {use} {unit} a day; {window} {unit} over the {hours} h window
intel_external.energy_hint: Metered use and cost at the last 30 days' average: the energy affected, not the production lost.
